paths.three: src/sim must stay pure: no rendering imports (CLAUDE.md hard rule 1).
paths.vite: src/sim must stay pure: no build-tool or browser imports.
paths.vite/client: src/sim must stay pure: no build-tool or browser imports.

patterns.message: src/sim must stay pure: no three.js addons or submodules.
src/sim must stay pure: no Node built-ins (the sim runs in the browser and in Node).
src/sim may import only src/sim/**, src/data/*.json and types from src/gen/assets.ts (TECHNICAL_DESIGN 2.1).

deniedGlobals.Date: No wall-clock time in src/sim: use the tick counter.
deniedGlobals.performance: No wall-clock time in src/sim: use the tick counter.
deniedGlobals.localStorage: No DOM in src/sim: persistence lives in src/app/save.ts.
deniedGlobals.requestAnimationFrame: No frame callbacks in src/sim: src/app/loop.ts drives the fixed tick.
deniedGlobals.cancelAnimationFrame: No frame callbacks in src/sim: src/app/loop.ts drives the fixed tick.
deniedGlobals.setTimeout: No timers in src/sim: count ticks instead.
deniedGlobals.setInterval: No timers in src/sim: count ticks instead.
deniedGlobals.crypto: No non-deterministic randomness in src/sim: use sfc32 from src/sim/rng.ts.
deniedGlobals.globalThis: No global escape hatches in src/sim (globalThis.Date, globalThis.Math.random).

entries.message: No Math.random in src/sim: use sfc32 from src/sim/rng.ts.
